en: Ti kreyon espwa is a Haitian NGO supporting vulnerable children across Haiti with education, nutrition and creative expression.
ht: Ti kreyon espwa se yon ONG ayisyen k ap sipòte timoun ki vilnerab toupatou an Ayiti nan edikasyon, nitrisyon ak ekspresyon kreyatif.

en: Education, nutrition and creative expression for vulnerable children in Haiti.
ht: Edikasyon, nitrisyon ak ekspresyon kreyatif pou timoun ki vilnerab an Ayiti.

ht: Ilistrasyon: yon timoun ayisyen ki souri, k ap kenbe yon kreyon anlè yon kaye ki louvri

ht: Yon timoun ayisyen ki souri, k ap kenbe yon kreyon anlè yon kaye ki louvri

en: Every child has a beautiful story to write.
ht: « Chak timoun gen yon bèl istwa pou l ekri »

en: walks alongside vulnerable children across Haiti — with school supplies, warm meals and safe spaces where they can create, speak and heal.
ht: mache bò kote timoun ki vilnerab toupatou an Ayiti — ak sak lekòl, repa cho ak kote ki an sekirite kote yo ka kreye, pale ak geri.

en: Every gift is tracked. Ask us what yours paid for — we will tell you.
ht: Nou swiv chak don. Mande nou kisa pa w te peye — n ap di w.
Sa n ap fè, chak semèn

en: School bags, supplies and reading corners so no child stays home for lack of a notebook.
ht: Sak lekòl, founiti ak kwen lekti pou pa gen timoun ki rete lakay paske li pa gen kaye.

en: Drawing, painting and storytelling sessions where children put words on what they carry.
ht: Sesyon desen, penti ak rakonte istwa kote timoun yo mete mo sou sa yo pote nan kè yo.

en: Hot meals and hygiene kits, because a hungry child cannot learn.
ht: Repa cho ak twous ijyèn, paske yon timoun ki grangou pa ka aprann.

en: A small pencil, a whole lot of hope
was born in Haiti, out of a simple conviction: a child holding a pencil is a child holding their own future. Our name says it — a small pencil, and hope: the child's, and their community's.
ht: fèt an Ayiti, ak yon konviksyon senp: yon timoun ki kenbe yon kreyon se yon timoun ki kenbe pwòp avni l. Non nou di l — yon ti kreyon, ak espwa: espwa timoun nan, ak espwa kominote l.

en: To support vulnerable children in Haiti by giving them access to education, proper nutrition and spaces for creative expression — so that poverty never becomes the reason a child stops dreaming.
ht: Sipòte timoun ki vilnerab an Ayiti lè n ba yo aksè nan edikasyon, bon nitrisyon ak kote pou yo eksprime kreyativite yo — pou povrete pa janm vin rezon ki fè yon timoun sispann reve.

en: We work close to families, schools and local leaders, one neighbourhood at a time, with full transparency on where every gourde and every dollar goes.
ht: Nou travay pre fanmi, lekòl ak lidè lokal yo, yon katye apre lòt, ak transparans total sou kote chak goud ak chak dola ale.

en: A Haiti where every child — whatever their neighbourhood, whatever their family's income — grows up fed, in school, and free to tell their own story.
ht: Yon Ayiti kote chak timoun — kèlkeswa katye l, kèlkeswa revni fanmi l — grandi byen manje, ale lekòl, epi lib pou rakonte pwòp istwa l.

en: We are building a generation of children who read, draw, speak up, and become the adults their community is waiting for.
ht: N ap bati yon jenerasyon timoun ki li, ki desine, ki pale, epi ki vin granmoun kominote a ap tann.

en: Children are actors of their own story, never a display of misery.
ht: Timoun yo se aktè pwòp istwa yo, pa janm yon espektak mizè.

en: Led by Haitians, in Haitian Creole, with the families we serve.
ht: Dirije pa Ayisyen, an Kreyòl ayisyen, ansanm ak fanmi n ap sèvi yo.

en: Every donation is tracked and reported back to those who gave it.
ht: Chak don swivi, epi nou voye rapò bay moun ki te fè l.

en: We stay. Real change is measured in school years, not in single visits.
ht: Nou rete. Chanjman reyèl mezire nan ane lekòl, pa nan vizit sèlman.

en: Three pillars, one child at a time
ht: Twa poto, yon timoun apre lòt

en: Education, creative healing and nutrition are not separate needs — a child needs all three at once. So we deliver all three, together.
ht: Edikasyon, gerizon pa atizay ak nitrisyon pa separe — yon timoun bezwen twa yo ansanm. Se sa k fè n ba yo twa yo, an menm tan.

en: Illustration: children receiving school bags and supplies
ht: Ilistrasyon: timoun k ap resevwa sak lekòl ak founiti

en: Nothing should stand between a child and a classroom — least of all the price of a notebook.
ht: Pa dwe gen anyen ki bloke yon timoun pou l antre nan klas — sitou pa pri yon kaye.

en: Full school kits: bag, notebooks, pencils, uniform
ht: Sak lekòl konplè: sak, kaye, kreyon, inifòm

en: Scholarships covering a full school year
ht: Bous pou kouvri yon ane lekòl konplè

en: Mini-libraries and reading corners in the neighbourhood
ht: Ti bibliyotèk ak kwen lekti nan katye yo
Sipò pou devwa ak pwofesè volontè

en: Illustration: children sitting in a circle, drawing and painting together
ht: Ilistrasyon: timoun ki chita an sèk, k ap desine ak pentire ansanm

en: Many of our children have seen too much. Art gives them a language when words are still too heavy.
ht: Anpil nan timoun nou yo wè twòp bagay. Atizay ba yo yon lang lè mo yo twò lou pou soti.
Atelye desen ak penti chak semèn

en: Storytelling and writing circles in Haitian Creole
ht: Sèk rakonte istwa ak ekriti an Kreyòl ayisyen
Sipò emosyonèl ak animatè ki fòme

en: Illustration: hot meals being served at a community canteen
ht: Ilistrasyon: repa cho k ap sèvi nan yon kantin kominotè

en: An empty stomach cannot hold a lesson.
ht: Yon vant vid pa ka kenbe yon leson.

en: keeps children fed, healthy and present.
ht: kenbe timoun yo byen manje, an sante epi prezan.

en: Hot meals served on workshop and school days
ht: Repa cho sèvi nan jou atelye ak jou lekòl

en: Hygiene kits: soap, toothbrush, sanitary supplies
ht: Twous ijyèn: savon, bwòs dan, pwodwi sanitè

en: Clean drinking water at every activity
ht: Dlo pwòp pou bwè nan chak aktivite

en: Health check-ups and referrals for the most fragile
ht: Tcheke sante ak referans pou timoun ki pi frajil yo

en: We would rather show you how we work than impress you with numbers we cannot back up. Here is what we commit to.
ht: Nou prefere montre w kijan n ap travay olye n enpresyone w ak chif nou pa ka pwouve. Men sa n angaje n pou.

en: We work in Haiti, with families we know by name — not through a distant office.
ht: Nou travay an Ayiti, ak fanmi nou konnen non yo — pa nan yon biwo ki lwen.

en: No child's face and no family's hardship is used to raise money. Ever.
ht: Nou pa janm sèvi figi yon timoun ni difikilte yon fanmi pou fè apèl pou lajan. Janm.

en: Ask what your donation paid for and we send you the answer, with the receipts.
ht: Mande kisa don ou te peye, n ap voye repons lan ba ou, avèk resi yo.

en: Haitian teachers, artists and neighbours run the programmes, week after week.
ht: Pwofesè ayisyen, atis ak vwazen k ap mennen pwogram yo, chak semèn.

en: Illustrations of our programmes — school days, workshops, shared meals. They are not photographs of the children we serve, and that is a deliberate choice.
ht: Ilistrasyon pwogram nou yo — jou lekòl, atelye, repa pataje. Se pa foto timoun n ap sèvi yo, epi se yon chwa nou fè.

en: Illustration: a child writing in a new notebook
ht: Ilistrasyon: yon timoun k ap ekri nan yon nouvo kaye

en: Illustration: children painting during a creative workshop
ht: Ilistrasyon: timoun k ap pentire nan yon atelye kreyatif

en: Illustration: a volunteer serving a hot meal
ht: Ilistrasyon: yon volontè k ap sèvi yon repa cho

en: Illustration: a reading corner with children choosing books
ht: Ilistrasyon: yon kwen lekti ak timoun k ap chwazi liv
Ilistrasyon: timoun ak volontè yo ansanm
N ap travay bò kote youn ak lòt

en: Illustration: children walking to school in the morning light
ht: Ilistrasyon: timoun k ap mache lekòl nan limyè maten an

en: AI-generated illustrations. We do not publish photographs of the children in our programmes.
ht: Ilistrasyon ki fèt ak IA. Nou pa pibliye foto timoun ki nan pwogram nou yo.

en: Why you will not see their faces
ht: Poukisa ou pa wè figi yo

en: The images on this site are AI-generated illustrations. A photograph of a child in need of help follows that child for life — online, at school, into adulthood. We are not willing to trade that for a donation. The programmes and the needs are real; the faces are not, and we would rather say so plainly.
ht: Imaj sou sit sa a se ilistrasyon ki fèt ak IA. Yon foto yon timoun ki nan bezwen swiv li tout lavi l — sou entènèt, nan lekòl, rive granmoun. Nou pa dakò fè echanj sa pou yon don. Pwogram yo ak bezwen yo reyèl; figi yo pa reyèl, epi nou prefere di sa klè.

en: Instead of children's portraits: what your gift bought, when, and for how many. Write to us and we send the breakdown — school kits, meals served, workshop materials — with the receipts behind it. Partners and institutions can request the same on paper.
ht: Olye pòtrè timoun: sa don ou te achte, kilè, ak pou konbyen moun. Ekri nou n ap voye detay la ba ou — sak lekòl, repa ki sèvi, materyèl atelye — avèk resi yo. Patenè ak enstitisyon ka mande menm bagay la sou papye.

en: Give a pencil, give a future
ht: Bay yon kreyon, bay yon avni

en: A school kit costs about 25 USD. A month of hot meals for one child, about 15 USD. Whatever you give lands directly in a child's hands in Haiti.
ht: Yon sak lekòl koute anviwon 25 USD. Yon mwa repa cho pou yon timoun, anviwon 15 USD. Nenpòt sa ou bay rive dirèk nan men yon timoun an Ayiti.
Fè don ak kat oswa PayPal

en: The fastest way to give from anywhere in the world — card, PayPal balance or bank account. Secure checkout on PayPal.
ht: Fason ki pi rapid pou bay kòb de nenpòt kote nan mond lan — kat, sòl PayPal oswa kont labank. Peman an sekirize sou PayPal.

en: For larger gifts, recurring support or institutional partners.
ht: Pou pi gwo don, sipò regilye oswa patenè enstitisyonèl.

en: Prefer to talk to a human, or give from Haiti? Call our donation line — we will walk you through it.
ht: Ou prefere pale ak yon moun, oswa bay kòb depi Ayiti? Rele liy don nou an — n ap gide w.

en: Teachers, artists, nurses, students — on site in Haiti or remotely (design, translation, admin). Tell us what you can give.
ht: Pwofesè, atis, enfimyè, elèv — sou plas an Ayiti oswa adistans (design, tradiksyon, admin). Di nou sa ou ka bay.

en: Sponsor a school year, fund a workshop cycle, or match your employees' gifts. We provide full reporting on the impact.
ht: Patwone yon ane lekòl, finanse yon sik atelye, oswa egalize don anplwaye ou yo. Nou bay rapò konplè sou enpak la.

en: Cover one child's school year, meals and workshops. You receive news, drawings and progress updates through the year.
ht: Kouvri ane lekòl, repa ak atelye yon timoun. Ou resevwa nouvèl, desen ak rapò sou pwogrè li pandan tout ane a.

en: Let's write the next chapter together
ht: Ann ekri pwochen chapit la ansanm

en: A question, a partnership idea, an offer to help? Write to us — a real person answers, usually within two days.
ht: Ou gen kesyon, yon lide patenarya, oswa ou vle ede? Ekri nou — yon moun reyèl ap reponn ou, anjeneral nan de jou.

en: Tell us how you would like to help, or what you would like to know.
ht: Di nou kijan ou ta renmen ede, oswa sa ou ta renmen konnen.

en: We never share your details. Fields marked * are required.
ht: Nou pa janm pataje enfòmasyon ou. Jaden ki make * obligatwa.

en: We never publish photographs of the children in our programmes. What you see here are illustrations.
ht: Nou pa janm pibliye foto timoun ki nan pwogram nou yo. Sa ou wè la se ilistrasyon.
